title: The Dilemma Lite WordPress plugin through 1.1.1 does not sanitise or escape the choices of dilemmas submitted by…
description: The Dilemma Lite WordPress plugin up to version 1.1.1 suffers from a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. It does not properly sanitize or escape user-submitted dilemma choices before displaying them in the admin dashboard and front end. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute in the context of administrators viewing the affected pages.
